summary.text: Paul Miskimins is a Republican state senator from South Dakota Senate District 20 who assumed office in January 2025 after serving in the state House from 2019 to 2023, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A dentist and farmer by profession, he sits on the Senate Appropriations Committee.

paragraphs.text: Paul Miskimins' career experience includes working as a dentist and farmer.
Miskimins represented South Dakota House of Representatives District 20 from 2019 to 2023 and assumed office in the State Senate on January 14, 2025.
In the 2025-2026 session he is assigned to the Senate Appropriations Committee.
